entities.summary: María Carlota Castrejana Fernández is a female triple jumper from Spain. Her personal best jump is 14.60 metres, achieved at the 2005 Mediterranean Games in Almería. This is the current national record. Carlota Castrejana was a athletes & competitors from Logroño (b. 1973-04-25, Logroño). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
